label: Existence in essence at an esse-essence identity: controls checked (inference)
rule: General laws and explicit finite models
meaning: Premise-free laws relating the senses of 'existence belongs to an essence' (conceptual containment, essential truth, act identity, consequential essential truth), Kant's conceptual thesis, concept adequacy, the identity-to-concept bridge, the act-fact link, exercise in the nature, existence-conditional essences and serious-actualist essences, then finite models: kantAquinas, conditionalIdentity, four Kant-adequacy omission models and two factorization omission models. Model-witnessed separations only; no premise is established and no reality claim is made.
